expected.fixed_repeat: identical seed, construction order, and process hash seed should reproduce the same partition
expected.integrity: every partition covers each node exactly once and recomputed modularity agrees within 1e-12
expected.seed_sweep: symmetric fixtures may produce more than one valid canonical partition across seeds 0-63
expected.stability_control: strongly separated cliques should remain three five-node communities

fixtures.bridge_node: four triangles and two symmetric bridge nodes with equal-weight choices
fixtures.separated_cliques: three K5 cliques joined in a ring by weight-0.05 edges

limitations: Louvain is a heuristic; a different valid partition is not by itself a NetworkX bug or contract violation.
The tested fixtures, seeds, insertion orders, interpreter, and NetworkX version do not establish behavior for other configurations.
PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed when the worker interpreter starts; the parent controls its environment and verifies the reported value, but that does not prove the algorithm causally used the hash seed.
No upstream contract violation is claimed without a separately reviewed specification boundary.
title: The Louvain Shape-Shifter
